about_the_game: This demo has two parts, Part A takes place in late game settings while Part B in early game settings. Both parts cover 2 major gameplay loops: Explore and Combat. The third gameplay loop: Character Progression will be included in the next demo in future.

short_description: Unleash stylish anime-inspired mech combat in this sidescroller beat 'em up RPG! Customize your build, master creative combos, and rise from broken parts to unstoppable legend in a world where every battle tests your skill—and every win is truly earned
